summary.title: Dive Bombing a Thessian: The God-Killing Gun Meets Gremory
summary.synopsis: Having rescued three Sedecium survivors from a folded shelter, the party explores the crashed Sedecium ship across multiple timeline iterations, scavenging phlogiston barrels, uncovering mission directives and key fragments, and ultimately diving through a wall of arcane energy to confront the Thessian Gremory (Esoterica) face-to-face — where Argyle immediately fires the god-killing gun.
key_beats: Session opens with recap and the party in the unfolded lobby alongside the three rescued Sedecium members (Slade, Vestiricoi, Pelicanceres); they learn about Thessians, the Astra, the Wick/Horizon, and that Gremory/Esoterica is aboard the ship

Party explores the dormitory: finds the captain's quarters and an officer's quarters, a personal terminal with a map of the Astra and mission directives (contain Gremory, locate 'the entity'), and enchanted 3D star-shaped key fragments forming a 16-pointed Sedecium star

Canteen exploration reveals reality-shifting mechanics — objects float and cycle through burned, amalgamated, and empty states with each heartbeat; touching walls/floor anchors you to that reality while floating shifts you between timelines
The party attempts to bypass the frozen blue coolant (Godblood/fuel) barrier; a table-umbrella approach fails as the liquid dissolves the metal

Johnny translocates past the barrier into the storage room (taking bludgeoning damage materializing inside a pallet), then loads a bag of holding with eight phlogiston barrels, four mystery barrels, metal cylinders, a flat pack, and freeze-dried fruit
Party debates whether killing Gremory in this timeline kills the future version; they rest in the Strider at year 72 to recover spells and hit points before the confrontation

Navigating multiple timeline iterations (72, 82, 94, 112, 122, 142) through the elevator shaft and maintenance tunnels, the party discovers the Helm is intact in timeline 94 — finding both a shelter and a research lab

Inside the shelter they find Oliver Day, a Nephilim researcher trapped for ~30 years surviving on conjured berries; he agrees to help and provides an ablative coating to survive the dive through the intense magic energy around the door
Argyle's Augury from the Judge overwhelmingly signals 'go'; the party learns the god-killing gun is a guaranteed hitscan weapon within 120 feet of a divine entity

The party dives from the top of the elevator shaft in present day, ablative coating burning away as they pierce through the magic barrier; they land in the engine room face-to-face with Gremory/Esoterica — a golden three-headed, six-armed figure wrapped in chains — who says 'Welcome, heroes,' and Argyle shoots it in the face with the god-killing gun
locations: Sedecium ship — dormitory (captain's quarters, officer's quarters)
Sedecium ship — Helm (bridge) / research lab / shelter
factions: Sedecium (coalition of ~4 dozen worlds on the outer rim of the Astra)
items: God-killing gun (hitscan within 120 ft of a divine entity)
16-pointed star key fragments (enchanted 3D star objects containing fragments of a large prime number)
Personal terminal (Astra map, mission directives, travel logs)
summary.cliffhanger: The party has plunged through the arcane barrier into the engine room and stands before the Thessian Gremory/Esoterica — a golden three-headed, six-armed entity wrapped in chains — who has just welcomed them as heroes, and Argyle has fired the god-killing gun directly into its face. Combat begins next session.
